sourceRefs.locator: Introduction and Physical Description. Tenth-century Gospel text, Gaelic additions on ff. 3–5, the Latin brieve on f. 40, and the 155 × 110 mm parchment codex.
In Ì Chaluim Chille, pp. 383–415. Discussion of Bishop Cormac and Book of Deer no. III, notes 53–54. Gartnait and Éte’s grant, the pledge, and dating between April 1131 and April 1132.

Opening paragraphs and the 2022 excavation. The team proposes a site about 80 metres from the later Deer Abbey near Mintlaw. The map gives the district rather than pinpointing the grant or place of writing.

note.de: Eine gälische Notiz überliefert ihre Schenkung und eine Sicherheit an Bischof Cormac. Die Karte verortet die Gemeinschaft von Deer, für die der Eintrag bestimmt war.
note.en: A Gaelic note records their grant and a pledge to Bishop Cormac. The map locates the community at Deer that the record concerned.
